00043 DebounceUGenInternal::DebounceUGenInternal(UGen const& input, UGen const& time) throw()
00044 : UGenInternal(NumInputs)
00045 {
00046  inputs[Input] = input;
00047  inputs[Time] = time;
00048  count = 0;
00049 }
00050 
00051 UGenInternal* DebounceUGenInternal::getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00052 {
00053  return new DebounceUGenInternal(inputs[Input].getChannel(channel),
00054          inputs[Time].getChannel(channel));
00055 }
00056 
00057 void DebounceUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00058 {
00059  const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00060  float* const outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00061  float* const inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00062  float* const timeSamples = inputs[Time].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00063  
00064  LOCAL_DECLARE(int, count);
00065  
00066  for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; i++)
00067  {
00068   // should un wrap this loop a bit..
00069   
00070   if(count > 0)
00071   {
00072    outputSamples[i] = 1.f;
00073    count--;
00074   }
00075   else
00076   {
00077    if(inputSamples[i] > 0.f)
00078    {
00079     outputSamples[i] = 1.f;
00080     count = timeSamples[i] * UGen::getSampleRate();
00081    }
00082    else
00083    {
00084     outputSamples[i] = 0;
00085    }
00086   }
00087  }
00088  
00089  LOCAL_COPY(count);
00090 }

00092 Debounce::Debounce(UGen const& input, UGen const& time) throw()
00093 {
00094  initInternal(input.getNumChannels());
00095  
00096  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00097  {
00098   internalUGens[i] = new DebounceUGenInternal(input, time);
00099  }
